messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — carrier flagged potential damage on 2 racks bound for EU dedicated cluster. ETA bumped +5 days. Partner is NovaRack. They asked who's on the hook for transit insurance and whether we want to apply our reservation buffer credits to affected dedicated commits. /cc @sam_partnerships :ambulance:

sam_partnerships: Which racks? manifest 83X? Any damage photos? If it's cross-border, customs + insurance caveats usual.

maria_ops: Yes manifest 83X. Uploading photos to ticket INC-4567 in ~10m. Carrier notes "scratch/dented rails", no power issues reported. They marked as 'possible rework required' which could extend hold.

orion_ops_bot: Ticket INC-4567 updated by maria_ops — status: at-risk, ETA_recalc: +5d.

james_orion: NovaRack's freight policy limits their statutory insurance for export shipments. They suggested we exercise the "buffer credits" clause in the reseller contract. Need legal confirmation before we debit customer commitments.

anna_product: We can't silently change customer delivery windows. If buffer credits get applied, we must notify customers and map to SLA credits. What's the customer impact (throughput/latency) if we shift capacity around?

liam_finance: Quick calc: if we pull 2 racks from EU pool and use fallback cloud capacity for ~2 weeks, estimated incremental spend ~ $45k. Buffer credits offset up to 30% of that per contract. Need final numbers from eng-runtime for throughput equivalence.

sam_partnerships: Action items: 1) maria get insurance certificate & damage photos into INC-4567. 2) legal_bot to confirm we can use buffer credits. 3) eng-runtime to confirm perf parity of fallback. 4) ops evaluate redeploy to non-EU pool as temporary.

legal_bot: Noted. Reviewing contract clause 5.3.b re: buffer credits and customer notice obligations. Expect response by EOD. :thinking: 

maria_ops: Uploaded photos + carrier photo report (in ticket). Reached out to NovaRack ops lead for insurance cert. If legal approves buffer credits, propose: reallocate 1 rack from non-EU pool immediately, keep 1 for rebuild. Will update by 16:30 UTC. :wave:

sam_partnerships: Agree. Keep marketing/product looped if we need joint announcement. Also ping CS for impacted customers list.

maria_ops: Will do. Tagging @anna_product and @cs_team to prep comms if needed. Closing loop: next update by 16:30 UTC or sooner.
